audienceTargeting.demographics: Male-skewing homeowners and farmers in rural and semi-rural Florida and Georgia zip codes, HHI $50K+, own their property
audienceTargeting.description: Landowners and small agricultural operators in FL and GA who have actively searched for contractors or building permits — people experiencing contractor frustration. Retarget website visitors and lookalike audiences of past leads.

bodyCopyVariations: You've got land. You need a structure. You don't have time to chase down contractors who never call back. South Dixie Storage delivers and installs your pole barn kit — start to finish. Get a free quote today.

Finding a reliable builder in South Florida or Georgia feels impossible. We get it. That's why South Dixie Storage ships your pole barn kit straight to your property and handles the installation too. One call. Done right.
Stop waiting on contractors. South Dixie Storage pole barn kits come with full delivery and professional installation — so you can get back to running your land instead of managing a build.
rows.headline: No Contractor? No Problem.
rows.imageDescription: Wide low-angle establishing shot of a newly completed steel pole barn on a flat green pasture in the Florida or Georgia countryside, photographed at golden hour with warm late-afternoon side-light raking across the corrugated metal panel walls. The barn is finished in a clean two-tone scheme — light warm beige metal panel walls with deep navy roll-up doors, two side-by-side 10-foot-wide by 10-foot-tall powder-coated steel roll-up doors visible on the front face, closed, with no rust, dents, or peeling. A South Dixie Storage delivery flatbed truck is parked on a clean gravel driveway in the mid-ground, hinting at recent completion. The foreground shows a neatly mowed green lawn edge. Sky is rich golden-hour blue fading to orange near the horizon. Composition uses a slight low camera angle — approximately 4 feet off ground — to convey scale and solidity. Rugged yet professional aesthetic, clean utilitarian layout, nothing flashy, no logos of any real company visible on the truck.

videoScript.cta: Visit SouthDixieStorage.com and get your free quote today.
videoScript.hook: Still waiting on a contractor to call you back?
scenes: Scene 1 — 0:00–0:03: Tight shot of a phone screen showing a long unanswered call log, hand sets the phone down on a wooden fence post. Cut to wide shot of empty land with no structure. Text overlay: 'Sound familiar?'

Scene 2 — 0:03–0:10: Time-lapse style quick cuts of a South Dixie Storage pole barn kit being unloaded from a flatbed truck on a grassy property, panels lifted into place, doors hung, structure complete — all on the same land parcel. Warm golden-hour light throughout. Text overlay: 'Kit delivered. Installed. Done.'

Scene 3 — 0:10–0:20: Satisfied landowner in worn work boots and a collared shirt stands at the open roll-up door of the finished navy-doored pole barn, arms crossed, looking satisfied at the clean interior. Camera slowly pulls back to show the full structure against a wide Georgia/Florida sky. Text overlay: 'South Dixie Storage — Delivered and Installed.'
